announcement.quote: Carlyle Secured Lending, Inc. Announces Merger with Carlyle Secured Lending III

deals.notes: Target CSL III is a private BDC (exchange fields on its 8-K cover read N/A); acquirer CGBD is NASDAQ-listed. For information only: the 2025-03-28 8-K (0001193125-25-065939) reports CGBD shareholder approval on March 26, 2025 with closing expected on or about March 27, 2025; no excerpt states the closing itself. Merger Agreement amended January 3, 2025 (425 of that date).
